name: Blinding Aura
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Uncheck a Condition. If you did, choose a creature within short range. That creature is surrounded by an aura of blinding light. Attacks against the creature are ill-favored. Additionally, whenever an attack targets the creature, roll Spirit vs Spirit against the attacker. On a win, the attacker must choose a different target. No effect on a loss.
successes:
✨: The attacker must move 10 ft away from the target if they are able.

🌞: The attack fails entirely.

💀: The spell ends after the attack is completed. Check a Condition.
